_note: UNTESTED as scene files. One representative weather per sky type with its Day settings (flat dotted paths; vector components .x/.y/.z/.w). "cloudLayer.cirrus.weather" is ONE value: the whole {"states": [...]} blend object. "PhysicalSky.periodOverrides" lists, per other period, only the keys that differ from Day. "globalOnly" must be set once globally (it cannot be driven per weather). Console: fw <formId>; NAT-ENB.esp ids need the load-order byte in place of the leading 00.

globalOnly.why: cloudLayer.cirrus.uvSize is scene-blacklisted; all three high-layer looks were tested at 3.0. It is in the pack Baseline.

anchors.globalBase: Saved in game: haze Continental loading 0.2 (aerosolScatter [2.522, 3.419, 4.575], aerosolAbsorption [0.1327, 0.1466, 0.1604]); height fog vanillaFogStrength 0.1 (0.4 / 0.3 washed out the Whiterun plain); low layer 1200 + 900 m, ndfScale [24.66, 16.7], primary.range [0.1, 0.65, 0, 0.65], cirrus densityScale 0.3.
anchors.haze: Heavy haze hides all cloud structure: storm at 2.4x the old base (loading 0.95) = featureless grey wall at midday; at 0.45x of that (loading 0.38 = 1.9x the new base) readable at dusk, still murky at midday. Ceilings used here, as multiples of the new base: overcast 1.5, rain 1.8, storm 1.6, snow 2.0, fog 3.0.
anchors.heightFog: Fog type at pass-2 values (FogPF strength 0.153, half-opacity ~260 m, haze loading 1.02) = near white-out at 13:00.
anchors.modeling: The modeling layer decides how much of the slab is filled; default [-0.5, 0.6, 0, 0.5] exponent 1.6 keeps every cloud in the lowest 10-40 % of its slab. Pass 2 never set it.
anchors.storm: Liked at dusk: sweeps/storm_towers.json 04_as03_low_wide_bases (primary [0, 0.5, 0, 0.95] exp 1, secondary [0.2, 0.8, 0, 0], modeling [-0.5, 0.5, 0.35, 1.0] exp 1, heightVariation [0.15, 0.75, 0.14, 0] exp 1, bottomTypeRange [-0.4, 0.5, 0, 0.1], 800 + 2600 m, density 1.0, bottomSpread 1.0 / 0.2, sunExtinction 1.6, viewExtinction 1.2, msAlbedo 0.992, ambientStrength 0.7) and 06_as04_more_cloud_narrow_gaps (same, primary.range.x -0.25).
anchors.rain: Liked at 17:30, fairly uniform at 13:00: sweeps/rain_structure.json 13_as12_dark_lighting (primary [-0.3, 0.45, 0, 0.9] exp 1, secondary [-0.3, 0.8, 0, 0.45], modeling [-0.5, 0.5, 0.2, 0.8] exp 1, 800 + 1700 m, density 0.9, sunExtinction 1.3, viewExtinction 1.1, msAlbedo 0.995, ambientStrength 0.8; heightVariation and bottomSpread at their defaults). AVOID (wavy streaks at low sun): 14_as13_low_wide_bases (heightVariation [0.15, 0.75, 0.10, 0] + bottomSpread 1.0 / 0.25) and 15 (the same with a coverage floor of 0.25).
anchors.fair: Liked: sweeps/small_fragments.json 07 (primary.range [0.25, 0.5, 0, 0.65], secondary off [-0.2, 0.8, 0, 0]): fewer, bolder, well-shaped cumulus with clean sky between.
anchors.overcast: Pass-2 overcast was too open (blue gaps).
anchors.cirrus: Popcorn = the dense-cell pattern channel. Tested looks (sweeps/high_cloud.json): 06 sparse streaks, 05 large streaky sheets (0.5 glared near the sun at midday), 08 thin veil. All with uvSize 3.
anchors.lightning: Whole-screen white flashes came from strikes as close as 0.35 km lighting thick fog near the camera.
anchors.ambient: Under a dark storm sky snow and terrain stayed brightly lit: part of the fill is the game weather ambient (ImageBasedLighting DALCAmount, Baseline 0.5). 0.25 was used in the liked storm and rain frames.
anchors.rayleigh: Rayleigh x2 = golden sunset at 17:30 but a pale midday sky.
anchors.terrain: Whiterun plain ~155 m, Ilinalta ~215 m, peaks ~770 m (scaled metres above the map floor).
anchors.drift: Pass-2 drift up to 15.6 / 31.2 m/s was never judged; capped at 9 m/s (low layer) here.

clear.label: Clear
clear.rationale: The liked fair-weather cut-off with a higher threshold: a few bold cumulus, small-fragment layer off; sparse high streaks.

fair.label: Fair-weather cumulus
fair.rationale: Lightest member = the liked small_fragments 07 look exactly; heavier members lower the threshold a little. Sparse high streaks.

partly.label: Partly cloudy
partly.rationale: Same sharp cut-off as fair with a lower threshold (consistent cloud shapes), on the saved 1200 + 900 slab; large streaky high sheets, thinner by day (glare).

overcast.label: Overcast
overcast.rationale: Closed deck: coverage reaches solid over most of the field (low input range, secondary layer filling the gaps, floor <= 0.12), modeling layer fills 25-75 % of the slab so thickness varies (light and dark underside). Rain-13 style defaults for heightVariation / bottomSpread (no low wide bases). Thin veil above the lightest members only.

rain.label: Rain
rain.rationale: Dark rain (RainPF) = the liked rain_structure 13 exactly, with a little more top-type spread in the Day period only (uniform at 13:00). Showers (bright-sun rain records) = a broken field with sunlit breaks under a thin veil.

storm.label: Thunderstorm
storm.rationale: Lightest members = the liked storm_towers 04 (separate dark towers, low wide bases); StormPF and heavier = 06 (same with narrow gaps). Haze near the base value so the towers stay readable; own lightning, kept away from the camera.

snow.label: Snow
snow.rationale: Light snow = thin broken cloud under a veil; steady snow = a closed, bright deck (overcast shapes, lighter lighting); blizzard = a deeper deck with its base at 800 m (peaks in cloud is right for a snowstorm).

fog.label: Fog
fog.rationale: The fog itself is haze + height fog (+ the optional Ground Fog); the cloud is a thin closed stratus deck with its base at 900 m or higher, clear of the peaks, lit softly so it reads as bright grey.

special.label: Other realm / map
special.rationale: Worldspace is not in the Physical Sky whitelist, so the file most likely never applies; clear values without a high layer.
